name: ai_content_studio_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the ai_content_studio capability.

prompts.name: script_generation
prompts.template: Write a detailed and engaging script about {topic} with a {tone} tone and approximately {length} words.
prompts.use_case: YouTube creators seeking to automate video production workflow

prompts.name: voiceover_generation
prompts.template: Generate a voiceover narration for the following script using {voice} voice at {speed} speed: {script}
prompts.use_case: Marketing teams generating consistent video content rapidly

prompts.name: video_creation
prompts.template: Create a video using the script and voiceover with the following template style: {template_style}
prompts.use_case: Educators producing educational videos with minimal manual effort

prompts.name: youtube_upload
prompts.template: Upload the video titled '{title}' with description '{description}' and tags {tags} to the YouTube channel.
prompts.use_case: Content marketers scaling video content for social media campaigns
